Purpose: authorize ready tasks to run in sequence.

Âge strictement positif au-delà duquel u: Strictly positive age beyond which a heartbeat is reported stale. Observation only: this proves neither process death nor a stop decision.
Âge strictement positif en millisecondes: Strictly positive age in milliseconds. At equality the lease remains present; beyond it another conductor may replace it. This threshold proves neither process death nor identity.
Écart futur maximal non négatif en milli: Maximum nonnegative future skew in milliseconds. Zero rejects any advance. Beyond it the lease is invalid; neither clock nor identity is authenticated.
Écart toléré, en pourcentage des jetons: Tolerated gap, in percent of the output tokens declared by the provider at the end of the attempt, with the sum of output tokens received through telemetry. Beyond it, the supervisor alert “usage gap” opens for the latest attempt of a task that is not accepted. Only output tokens are compared: input semantics differ by provider. A gap signals incomplete telemetry or a diverging declaration; it does not say which is right. Null disables the rule. 10 is an installation choice, editable.
